iittala - Alvar Aalto Clear Large Finlandia Vase - A shape constantly interpreted, the Alvar Aalto collection of vases stays true to the original design concept. More than 70 years after the original debut, the design continues to provoke attention by letting the owner decide its use and complementing our busy lives with a touch of nature. Filled with fresh cut flowers or arranged with other collection pieces as works of art, this eternal classic is essential to the modern home. The Aalto glass pieces have a multi-stage production. The non-leaded crystal is first mouth blown before going into a wooden mold to create the classic Aalto shape. The pieces are then hand cut and go through several polishing and finishing steps before they are completed, creating a piece worthy of permanent display at the Museum of Modern Art. In addition to the standard Aalto colors, each year iittala selects two new glass colors to run in limited production. Features: -Includes one vase -Mouth blown non-leaded crystal -Features designer's signature on the bottom -Not dishwasher safe, hand wash only -Overall dimensions: 10" H

Wild West Royalty Scapbook : Wild West Days is an annual event, and big doings, in Viroqua, Wisconsin. As with many other events and towns, each year a court of royalty is chosen and coronated to represent and promote at meet and greets, banquets, parades, benefits, fundraisers, coronations and other events. Some community service is included. It is not a beauty contest, nor is it about pageantry. The girls are held to a very high standard. Their grades must be kept up. Anything they do reflects back on the event and/or town they represent. They must conduct themselves in a lady-like fashion. Being on court is considered an honor, and getting there means a full year of madness for the girls and their parents since there are events to attend nearly every weekend. The girls develop an instant kinship, and because of the unique common experience, girls from other courts share a sense of family. To make a long story short, imagine how it felt when our daughter, Grace, was coronated Miss Wild West a short time back! Six girls in total were placed on the 2013 court. She has a first and second attendant. There is also a Junior Miss and her first attendant, and a Little Miss. They are advised by a most remarkable and dedicated couple who give of themselves with selfless devotion. Parents are, and need to be, heavily involved, because amid all the fun, there is also a good deal of work. That having been said, our first event of the year was Syttende Mai in Westby, Wisconsin. And so ... it begins.
